mapper.select: SELECT c.*, m.model_name, m.model_brand, p.parking_name FROM car c JOIN model m ON c.model_id = m.model_id JOIN parking p ON c.rental_station = p.parking_id WHERE c.car_id = #{carId}

SELECT u.user_name as userName, r.rental_date as rentalDate, r.return_date as returnDate, r.status FROM reservations r JOIN user u ON r.user_num = u.user_num WHERE r.car_id = #{carId} ORDER BY r.rental_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE car SET car_status = #{carStatus}, car_year = #{carYear}, car_fuel = #{carFuel}, car_grade = #{carGrade}, car_options = #{carOptions}, rental_station = #{rentalStation} WHERE car_id = #{carId}
mapper.select: SELECT parking_id as id, parking_name as name FROM parking ORDER BY name
SELECT model_id as id, model_name as name, model_brand as brand FROM model ORDER BY name
